question: How does the promoted coordinator-free causal-floor rho090 policy compare with exactly the existing five-seed PFQ experiment?
floor: ceil(0.90 * own-current-state PFQ+CTBS draft total dequeue); recomputed eachTTI, no external floor schedule.
baseline: Reuse verified PFQ seeds41..45 from boundary08_steady_state_20261021_v1; baseline hashes frozen before new native runs.
simulator: Reuse the exact continuous-clock corrected native binary used by PFQ, genFastFadingGpu(t); no rebuild or physics changes.
selection: rho090 was fixed on prior seed41 short-window development comparison; no reselection using this five-seed experiment. Seed41 is not an unseen validation seed.
statistics: Seed is independent unit n5; equal-seed mean/sampleSD and current_rho090-PFQ nominal95% paired tCI df4; no multiplicity correction; windows/packets not independent repetitions.

stationarity.windows: ten nonoverlapping1s windows within measurement; first5s vs last5s
stationarity.predeclared_flags: absolute first-half vs second-half goodput change >5% of overall mean, or net queue drift >1% offered traffic, or absolute queue linear trend >1% offered traffic; inspect all seeds/arms and do not label unpassed runs steady
stationarity.interpretation: finite-horizon practical stability diagnostics, not proof of capacity or asymptotic stationarity; TTL may stabilize overloaded queues by dropping

required_evidence: Fresh current-state floor independent discrete TBS/queue parity on every decision
CommonPFQ4000 and full-input/CTBS4001 pairing; exogenousH/W and traffic/topology throughout
Full convergence and no256 cap; no BC/coordinator inference or external floor reads
Six direct physical samples and first4001 continuous-channel recurrence
FIFO packet/byte conservation, complete measured-arrival cohort no censoring
detail_outputs: PerUE full metrics and matchedUE deltas
Raw native UE-TTI metrics binary and action/input fingerprints
Queue stability, gain mass-balance contributions, source/runtime identities
stop: Exactly five new rho090 trajectories after short seed41/45 validity checks; retain failed results, no tuning, extra seeds, or duration changes.
limitations: Finite10s window is not asymptotic steady-state or capacity proof; TTL may stabilize overloaded queues.
The prior1s selection used a periodic channel-clock binary. This experiment matches the PFQ continuous-clock baseline; old/new absolute changes are not single-factor policy effects.
Frozen legacy MCS3 scoring retained to isolate the selected policy; no lookup correction.
Shared-host concurrent wall time is not controlled deployment latency.
